page.overview:
Who is Corvax?

Lady Corvax was a Force-sensitive humanoid female individual who resided on the planet Mustafar along with her husband, Dorwin. When the latter fell in battle, she attempted to resurrect him by using the Mustafarians' most sacred artifact, the Bright Star. Instead, the energies unleashed completely destroyed the surface of Mustafar. However, a descendant of hers destroyed the Bright Star and freed Dorwin, allowing Mustafar to slowly heal.

Lady Corvax was born before 1032 BBY. Long before the rise of the Galactic Empire, Lady Corvax and her husband, Dorwin Corvax, resided on Mustafar, which was then a lush planet thriving with life, and the couple lived in harmony with the natives. One fateful day, however, Mustafar came under attack, and Dorwin fell in battle, sword in hand. Struck with grief, the woman stole the most sacred artifact of the Mustafarians, the Bright Star crystal, to power her Aeon Engine, which she hoped could resurrect her love.

That attempt, however, utterly failed. Not only was Dorwin cursed to be trapped between the real world and what came after,
